status: frozen synthetic holdout for BNK-PDF-1 G6; sealed and committed before the product was run on any of its files
question: Does bank-statement-native-1, built on statements printed by one Chromium writer, read and reconcile statements printed by two other PDF producers, telling new stories within the same contract, with every eligible positive completed and no false automatic approval?

producers: LibreOffice Writer PDF export (writer_pdf_Export): office document layout, embedded font subsets, LibreOffice's own shaping and right-to-left ordering
ReportLab canvas: strings placed one by one; the standard Helvetica Type 1 font not embedded, or an embedded TrueType subset; Arabic shaped by arabic-reshaper and put in visual order by python-bidi
geometry: column widths and margins of each producer
changed.furniture: bank names, document titles and accounts other than the foundation's
changed.references: bank-style FT and CHQ references, SADAD references with an inner space, a reference differing only in letter case between the sides
changed.relationships: a referenced pair beside an unreferenced twin of the same amount and day, three equal card settlements against two payments, amounts one riyal apart, opposite directions, the same reference and amount seven days apart, a payment booked twice in the cashbook, an outward transfer returned under the same reference, a fee and a commission on the statement only, an unpresented cheque and a deposit in transit, value dates before and after the period, balances overdrawn throughout
changed.faults: a brought-forward balance 100.00 above the carried-forward one, page 3 of 4 missing, page 2 of 3 printed twice
changed.cashbookXlsx: H01 as a typed XLSX (real dates and numbers) and H07 as a text XLSX, both saved by LibreOffice Calc; every cashbook also as CSV

heldConstant: the contract's column headings, control-line labels and Page n of N footer, in English and Arabic
the account/currency/period line as one line
dates as yyyy-mm-dd, SAR with two decimals, thousands separators, the DR suffix for an overdrawn balance
a real text layer; no scanned page

independence.author: The same assistant wrote the product, the foundation, the oracle and this holdout, and knew the product's reader when designing the stories. This is not a blind holdout: the stories and the producers are new to the product, the author is not.
independence.oracle: audit/bank-statement-foundation/oracle.py, unchanged: it reads the printed lines in the facts, the cashbook CSV and the contract, never recipe or intent, and imports nothing from the generator or the product. expected.py only runs it story by story with each story's own period.
independence.verifier: pdfminer.six, a PDF reader unrelated to the product's pdf.js, finds every printed value of the facts on its page (verify.py, with its own self-test).
independence.generator: stories.py is a new lineage in Python; nothing is imported from the foundation's stories.mjs or renderer.
independence.notTuned: The product was not run on these files, and no product code changed, between the start of G6 and the seal.

eligibility.why: Every statement stays inside the contract: its headings, labels, footer, line kinds, number and date formats and matching policy. The producer, font, geometry, period and story are what the contract leaves open.

measures.reading: Every printed line read from the PDF equals the facts: kind, page, dates, reference, amounts, balances; descriptions and continuation text after NFKC and whitespace normalisation.
measures.result: The matching result, in the facts' keys, equals EXPECTED.json: automatic pairs, review groups with their reasons, both outstanding sides, timing, and held statements with their counts.
measures.capacity: Eligible positives whose result equals EXPECTED.json from upload through matching, save, restore and Excel in the browser.
measures.falseAutomatic: Automatic pairs that EXPECTED.json does not hold, over all twelve statements. Must be zero.
measures.held: A held statement is held whole, with the oracle's status, and nothing in it approved, suggested or called outstanding.
measures.refusal: A positive the product refuses, or holds without the oracle holding it, is a failed positive, never a correct abstention.

afterRun: Results are recorded as they come, with the commit they ran on. A fix made after seeing them turns this set into regression for that fix; a new claim of generalisation needs a new holdout.
